environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate with Go 1.10.8 runtime container (golang:1.10.8-alpine). Origin is in a private subnet with security group restricting inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using custom header validation (X-Origin-Verify with rotating secret via Secrets Manager + Lambda@Edge). CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior with Viewer Request policy that enforces CloudFront signed URLs (Trusted Key Group with RSA-2048 key pair, policy requires matching resource path pattern). Unsigned or malformed requests receive 403 from CloudFront edge before reaching origin. CloudFront's edge processing normalizes HTTP headers by stripping CR/LF characters (0x0D, 0x0A) from query string parameter values before forwarding to origin per CloudFront's built-in request sanitization behavior (RFC 7230 compliance at edge). The distribution uses cache policy CachingDisabled with origin request policy AllViewer to forward all headers but CloudFront still applies its standard header normalization pipeline.

config.network: private subnet, SG inbound restricted to com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list
config.cdn: CloudFront distribution with OAC, signed URLs via Trusted Key Group
config.origin_verify: X-Origin-Verify custom header with rotating secret (Secrets Manager + Lambda@Edge rotation every 60min)
config.cloudfront_behavior: Viewer Request requires valid signed URL (RSA-2048, Trusted Key Group), edge normalization strips CR/LF from forwarded query parameters per RFC 7230 compliance
config.direct_origin_access: blocked by security group + OAC verification
